in_sanskrit.name: रविशेखर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Ravi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ravi', which means 'Sun'. Shekhar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shikhar', which means 'mountain' or 'peak'. So, Ravishekhar can be interpreted as 'Sun on the Peak of Wisdom' or 'Shining God of Wisdom'.

in_tamil.name: ரவிசேகர
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Ravi is derived from the Tamil word 'இழிலையின்' (Izhilaiyin), which means 'Sun'. Shekhar is derived from the Tamil word 'மலையின் சேவையர்' (Malaiyin Sevaivar), which means 'God of the Mountain'. vedic_reference.note: Ravi is a name of the Sun God in Hindu mythology, and Shekhar is a name of Lord Indra, the God of the clouds and rain. The combination of these two names represents the idea of the Sun shining on the peak of wisdom, which is a metaphor for enlightenment or spiritual growth.
